headwords: phi công trẻ lái máy bay bà già

flags.why: In this chant, ra means to show a hand gesture, not to have or get something.
flags.fix: Rock paper scissors—what will you show? Show this!

flags.why: Phi công trẻ does not mean bachelor; its figurative meaning concerns a younger man's relationship with an older woman.

flags.headword: phi công trẻ lái máy bay bà già
flags.why: This expression can mock the couple and carries a derogatory implication, as documented in this [linguistic study](https://jos.hueuni.edu.vn/index.php/HUJOS-SSH/article/download/3952/140/11116).
flags.fix: Add derogatory to the existing tags.

flags.headword: phi công trẻ lái máy bay bà già
flags.why: Máy bay bà già means an old plane in the metaphor, not a plane belonging to an old lady.
flags.fix: People call them a 'young pilot flying an old plane'—a younger man dating an older woman.
